---
title: "Research"
---

My work sits at the intersection of soil microbial ecology, biogeochemical cycling, and long-term agricultural management. I study how agricultural practices shape soil communities and nitrogen cycling through molecular microbiology, bioinformatics, and statistical analysis.

## Research Skills

**Molecular and Genomic Approaches:** DNA/RNA extraction, qPCR, amplicon sequencing, metagenomics, and metatranscriptomics

**Computational and Statistical Analysis:** R-based microbial community analysis, multivariate statistics, differential abundance testing, and data visualization

**Field and Ecological Research:** Soil sampling, soil-property assessment, gas-flux measurement, camera-trap deployment, and bird surveys
